# Product teardown — Style Prompt

> A real object lit like a studio packshot on a dark seamless sweep and taken apart in front of the camera: the layers lift on one axis, the camera travels between them and dives onto the one part that matters, every part is named with the numbers it really has, and the object closes again and gets its dimensions drawn on it.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

A frame reads as this style when:

- **the object is exact**: positions, counts and sizes come from the product's own spec, drawing or measurement. Nothing is eyeballed that a datasheet can give;
- **it is shown apart**: layers float on one vertical axis with even, readable gaps, each still oriented as it sits in the product, the topmost layer in front;
- **it is lit, not drawn**: a key from above front, a thin cool rim along every upper edge, a soft contact shadow on an invisible floor;
- **the numbers live on the object**: thin leaders from a dot on the part to a label column, dimension lines with ticks drawn in the object's own perspective, never a table beside it;
- **the camera never stops travelling**: a push on the closed object, a pull to the exploded view, a dive to one part, a pull back.

It is not a glass product render (one beautiful object, no disassembly), not a blueprint (line drawing on a grid, no light), not a stage talk (slides and headline type) and not an assembly manual (step numbers, arrows, hands).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- Each layer is its own group drawn once, in a three-quarter view from above: ellipses with a fixed ratio (about 0.28 of the width) for tops, rims and openings, straight sides, a front arc for the lower edge. Move whole layers, never redraw them.
- Each material keeps its character, drawn with gradients: plastic cream with a soft left-to-right falloff, aluminium brighter with a darker interior, cast iron near black with a lighter top, brass with a warm gradient. Every shape has a dark 2 px outline so it holds on a pale ground.
- The cool rim is a 3 px line at 55 % opacity along the back edge of each top ellipse. Do not blur it.
- Floor: one radial gradient ellipse under the lowest layer, moved with the object. No reflection plane.
- Emitters (a heating element, an LED ring) are strokes in the accent that fade in while the object is apart; no glow filter.
- Effects anchored to the object (leaders, dimension lines) are drawn in the same coordinates as the object, so they travel with the camera; only subtitles and the title card live in screen space.

**Where the numbers come from.** Ask the user for the spec sheet, the parts list or measurements of their own product, and show no number you could not source. Without a source, show the part and its name and leave the number out.

## 3. Colour logic

- The product brings its own colours (fixed materials); the frame around it is neutral. On a dark brand the product is the brightest thing; on a pale brand the outlines keep it readable.
- `--latar` is the sweep's edge, `--latar-2` its centre. `--teks` for names and subtitles, `--teks-redup` for the number line.
- **One signal colour**, `--utama`, reserved for measured and active things: label indices, dimension lines, the glowing element, the one matching detail on the product (a lever), the contact tag. Words and lines in it use `--utama-di-latar`; the lever fill uses `--utama` with `--teks-di-utama` text.
- `--aksen` is the cool rim light, only as thin lines.
- Fixed: the product materials (cream, aluminium, iron, brass) and the dark outline.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` (Space Grotesk 700): the title in the corner (60 px) and the closing headline (84 px); never over the object.
- `--font-isi` (Inter 600/400): part names (34 px) and subtitles (42 px, centred in the bottom 12 %, soft shadow and no box); the closing line (32 px).
- Numbers and indices in a monospace (`--font-kode`, IBM Plex Mono 400/600, 21–28 px) so digits line up and read as measurement. Units always written (mm, W, °C, ×n for counts).
- Label structure is fixed: two-digit index, name, one line of numbers. Dimension text sits on a small plate of the background colour and follows the line's angle, never upside down. Leave room: a brand's font may be wider.

## 5. Motion quality

- Separation: smooth start, fast middle, long settle (`power3.inOut`, 1.6 s). Layers leave top first, 0.18 s apart.
- Closing: bottom first, 0.15 s apart, 0.8 s each; the last layer lands with a small mechanical tap (down 6 px in 0.1 s, back in 0.15 s). Nothing bounces like rubber unless it is rubber.
- Labels: dot pops in (0.25 s, small overshoot), leader draws in 0.55 s, text slides 12 px in 0.4 s, 0.22 s between labels; they fade out in 0.25 s before the parts move again. A held label stays at least 2.5 s.
- A part performs its true mechanical motion once (a press, a latch, a spring) with a short elastic settle.
- The closed object gets a slow push (about 5 % over 3 s) while it waits.
- Never moves: the label column's x position, the light's relation to the camera.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Slow push on the closed object | the whole, a promise | an opening; a title |
| Pull to the exploded view while layers separate | order of assembly | a reveal; a structure overview |
| Dive to one part (scale about 2.6, other layers dimmed to 35 %) | the part that matters | a sensor, a seal, a thermostat, a fuse |
| Hold while the part moves | how it works | a latch, a switch, a spring |
| Pull back while the layers close | return, synthesis | a closing; a before/after |
| Still view with dimensions | scale and precision | sizes, thickness, fit |

- At key moments the object fills at least a third of the frame height. Labels live in a column on the free side (x about 1180 of 1920), subtitles in the bottom 12 %.
- Transitions are camera moves through the object itself. No cuts to black, no slide transitions, no split screens.

## 7. Native moves

- **The tap.** One small knock on the closed object before it opens. *Fits content like:* a repair shop's before-and-after, a handmade box's lid, a class opening a classroom model.
- **The stagger lift.** Layers rise top first on one axis. *Fits content like:* a leather wallet's lining, a bike's battery pack, a home-made cake's tiers.
- **The leader that lands on the part.** A label whose line ends on a dot on the component. *Fits content like:* a fuse in an appliance, a stitch type in a bag, a reed in a harmonica.
- **Dive to the one that fails.** The camera fills the frame with a single part. *Fits content like:* a thermostat, a hinge, a bicycle hub.
- **One real motion.** The part moves as it really does, once. *Fits content like:* a buckle, a latch, a switch, a spring.
- **Lights on inside.** An element switches on while the object is apart. *Fits content like:* a heater, status LEDs, a backlit sign.
- **Dimensions drawn on the thing.** After closing, the outline gets dimension lines in perspective. *Fits content like:* a case for a phone repair, furniture, a pot for a kitchen class.

## 8. Pitfalls

- **Invented numbers.** A size no source gives. Fix: leave it out or say it is measured.
- **Overlap that hides the part.** A lower layer drawn above an upper one. Fix: topmost layer drawn last; front wall of the base above the inner layers.
- **Layers too close.** Their ellipses cover each other's labels. Fix: gaps at least a layer's height; spread label slots by 120 px or more.
- **Text on a bright part.** Labels over the object. Fix: labels only in the column, leaders end 20 px before the text.
- **Dead macro.** A dive on a part that does nothing. Fix: the part performs its motion, with the camera held still.
- **Blurred rim light.** Filters on large shapes slow every frame. Fix: thin outline strokes only.
- **Clipped label.** A long name in a boxed plate. Fix: size the plate to the text.

# Product teardown: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 3, long 4.5.

## hook

- en: the closed product turns slowly on a dark seamless sweep, lit like a packshot; one tap on the lid, title small in a corner
- id: produk utuh di latar gelap mulus, dipotret seperti packshot, kamera mendorong pelan; satu ketukan di tutup, judul kecil di sudut

## problem

- en: the layers lift apart, top first 0.18 s apart, and the camera dives into the gap to the part that fails
- id: lapisan terangkat, atas dulu selisih 0,18 detik, kamera menyelam ke celah menuju bagian yang sering rusak

## fact

- en: leaders grow from dots on each layer to a label column: index in the accent, name, one line of numbers; held still
- id: garis penunjuk tumbuh dari titik di tiap lapis ke kolom label: indeks beraksen, nama, satu baris angka; ditahan diam

## step

- en: one layer at a time lifts out in order while the rest dims; its label opens before the camera settles
- id: satu lapis terangkat bergantian sesuai urutan, yang lain meredup; labelnya terbuka sebelum kamera berhenti

## compare

- en: two states of one part side by side on the same axis, each held still before the difference is named
- id: dua keadaan satu bagian berdampingan di sumbu yang sama, masing-masing ditahan diam sebelum bedanya disebut

## number

- en: a dimension line draws on the closed object in perspective, ticks first, then the value on a small plate
- id: garis ukuran digambar di benda jadi mengikuti perspektif, tanda ujung dulu, lalu angka di pelat kecil

## proof

- en: macro on one part: the camera fills the frame with it, a leader lands on it, and it performs its real motion once
- id: makro satu bagian: kamera memenuhi layar dengannya, garis penunjuk mendarat di situ, bagian itu bergerak asli satu kali

## offer

- en: the layers close bottom first, about 0.8 s each, the lid lands last with a small mechanical tap; card text slides in
- id: lapisan menutup dari bawah, sekitar 0,8 detik tiap lapis, tutup mendarat terakhir dengan ketukan kecil; teks kartu masuk

## cta

- en: the closed object with its dimensions drawn on it; name, offer and contact in the label column; held 2 s
- id: benda tertutup dengan ukurannya tergambar; nama, tawaran, dan kontak di kolom label; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: fast pull back to the whole object, closed and dimensioned, the sweep darkening at the edges; held 2 s
- id: kamera mundur cepat ke seluruh benda, tertutup dan berukuran, tepi latar menggelap; diam 2 detik

<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>Bongkar produk</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Space Grotesk"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #0d0e10; --latar-2: #34363a; --utama: #ff6b3d; --aksen: #7fb4d8;
        --teks: #f1efe9; --teks-redup: #a9a69f; --teks-di-utama: #14161a; --teks-di-aksen: #0d0e10;
        --utama-di-latar: #ff6b3d; --aksen-di-latar: #7fb4d8;
        --font-judul: "Space Grotesk", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Milik gaya ini: font angka dan bahan produk, tetap di semua brand. */
        --font-kode: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
        --krem-1: #f4f0e6; --krem-2: #cfc9b8; --krem-3: #7d786b; --baja-1: #eef1f3; --baja-2: #a3acb4; --baja-3: #4d555c;
        --besi-1: #52555b; --besi-2: #2a2c30; --besi-3: #121315; --kuningan-1: #f2d57f; --kuningan-2: #98712a; --garis: #1b1c1f;
        --bayang: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 70%, black);
      }
      * {margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
      html, body {width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--latar);}
      #root {position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--latar);color:var(--teks);font-family:var(--font-isi);}
      .isi {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;}
      /* Latar mulus: pusat terang, tepi gelap, produk selalu paling terang. */
      #sapu {background:radial-gradient(ellipse 62% 70% at 40% 46%, var(--latar-2), var(--latar) 78%);}
      svg {overflow:visible;}
      .k1 {fill:url(#gKrem);stroke:var(--garis);stroke-width:2;stroke-linejoin:round;} .b1 {fill:url(#gBaja);stroke:var(--garis);stroke-width:2;}
      .s1 {fill:url(#gBesi);stroke:var(--garis);stroke-width:2;} .g1 {fill:url(#gKuning);stroke:var(--garis);stroke-width:1.5;}
      .gl {fill:var(--besi-3);stroke:var(--garis);stroke-width:2;} .tipis {fill:none;stroke:var(--garis);stroke-opacity:0.35;stroke-width:2;}
      /* Cahaya pinggir dingin dari belakang: tepi atas tiap lapis. */
      .rim {fill:none;stroke:var(--aksen);stroke-opacity:0.55;stroke-width:3;}
      .kumparan {fill:none;stroke:var(--besi-3);stroke-width:9;} .nyala {fill:none;stroke:var(--utama);stroke-width:7;}
      .pegas {fill:none;stroke:var(--kuningan-2);stroke-width:4;}
      .dim {fill:none;stroke:var(--utama-di-latar);stroke-width:2.6;stroke-dasharray:1 1;stroke-dashoffset:1;}
      .dt {font:600 28px var(--font-kode);fill:var(--utama-di-latar);text-anchor:middle;} .dp {fill:var(--latar);}
      /* Label: indeks beraksen, nama, satu baris angka. */
      .lab {position:absolute;left:1180px;width:640px;white-space:nowrap;}
      .lab b {display:block;font:600 22px/1 var(--font-kode);color:var(--utama-di-latar);margin-bottom:8px;}
      .lab strong {display:block;font:600 34px/1.1 var(--font-isi);color:var(--teks);}
      .lab span {display:block;font:400 21px/1.3 var(--font-kode);color:var(--teks-redup);margin-top:6px;}
      .lead {fill:none;stroke:var(--teks);stroke-opacity:0.75;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-dasharray:1 1;stroke-dashoffset:1;} .dot {fill:var(--utama-di-latar);}
      .tag {position:absolute;left:110px;top:96px;}
      .tag b {display:block;font:600 22px/1 var(--font-kode);color:var(--utama-di-latar);letter-spacing:0.08em;margin-bottom:18px;}
      .tag h1 {font:700 60px/1.05 var(--font-judul);color:var(--teks);}
      /* Subtitel: strip tengah di bawah, bayangan lembut tanpa kotak. */
      .sub {position:absolute;left:0;top:928px;width:1920px;text-align:center;text-shadow:0 2px 12px var(--bayang);}
      .sub p {font:600 42px/1.15 var(--font-isi);color:var(--teks);white-space:nowrap;}
      .sub small {display:block;margin-top:8px;font:400 22px/1 var(--font-kode);color:var(--teks-redup);}
      .kartu {position:absolute;left:1090px;top:330px;width:740px;}
      .kartu b {display:block;font:600 24px/1 var(--font-kode);color:var(--utama-di-latar);letter-spacing:0.08em;}
      .kartu h2 {margin:22px 0 26px;font:700 84px/1.04 var(--font-judul);color:var(--teks);}
      .kartu p {font:400 32px/1.35 var(--font-isi);color:var(--teks-redup);}
      .kartu em {display:inline-block;margin-top:34px;padding:16px 30px;font:600 34px/1 var(--font-kode);font-style:normal;background:var(--utama);color:var(--teks-di-utama);}
      .garis-k {position:absolute;left:1090px;top:300px;width:740px;height:3px;background:var(--utama-di-latar);transform-origin:0 0;}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <div class="isi" id="sapu"></div>
      <svg class="isi" id="dunia" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080">
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="gKrem" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" style="stop-color: var(--krem-1)" /><stop offset="0.5" style="stop-color: var(--krem-2)" /><stop offset="1" style="stop-color: var(--krem-3)" /></linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="gBaja" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" style="stop-color: var(--baja-1)" /><stop offset="0.45" style="stop-color: var(--baja-2)" /><stop offset="1" style="stop-color: var(--baja-3)" /></linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="gBesi" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" style="stop-color: var(--besi-1)" /><stop offset="1" style="stop-color: var(--besi-3)" /></linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="gKuning" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" style="stop-color: var(--kuningan-1)" /><stop offset="1" style="stop-color: var(--kuningan-2)" /></linearGradient>
          <radialGradient id="gLantai"><stop offset="0" style="stop-color: var(--bayang)" stop-opacity="0.85" /><stop offset="1" style="stop-color: var(--bayang)" stop-opacity="0" /></radialGradient>
        </defs>
        <g id="cam"><g id="obj" transform="translate(680 640) scale(0.74)">
          <ellipse cx="0" cy="226" rx="470" ry="96" fill="url(#gLantai)" />
          <!-- Bodi luar: bagian belakang (mulut gelap), lalu bagian depan di atas semua isi. -->
          <g id="bb"><ellipse class="k1" cx="0" cy="0" rx="300" ry="84" /><ellipse class="gl" cx="0" cy="3" rx="268" ry="74" /><path class="rim" d="M-300 0A300 84 0 0 1 300 0" /></g>
          <!-- Lapis 4: termostat magnetik (kuningan, pegas, magnet). -->
          <g id="P4"><path class="g1" d="M-46 0V-34H46V0A46 13 0 0 1 -46 0Z" /><ellipse class="g1" cx="0" cy="-34" rx="46" ry="13" /><rect class="g1" x="-70" y="-14" width="26" height="9" /><rect class="g1" x="44" y="-14" width="26" height="9" />
            <g id="spr"></g><g id="pis"><rect class="g1" x="-8" y="-74" width="16" height="42" /><path class="b1" d="M-30 -74V-62A30 8 0 0 0 30 -62V-74Z" /><ellipse class="b1" cx="0" cy="-74" rx="30" ry="8" /></g>
            <path class="rim" d="M-46 -34A46 13 0 0 1 46 -34" /></g>
          <!-- Lapis 3: pelat pemanas besi cor dengan tiga cincin kumparan. -->
          <g id="P3"><path class="s1" d="M-270 0V24A270 76 0 0 0 270 24V0A270 76 0 0 1 -270 0Z" /><ellipse class="s1" cx="0" cy="0" rx="270" ry="76" /><g id="kum"></g><g id="nyala"></g>
            <ellipse class="gl" cx="0" cy="2" rx="52" ry="15" /><path class="rim" d="M-270 0A270 76 0 0 1 270 0" /></g>
          <!-- Lapis 2: panci dalam aluminium. -->
          <g id="P2"><rect class="s1" x="-268" y="-2" width="20" height="14" /><rect class="s1" x="248" y="-2" width="20" height="14" />
            <path class="b1" d="M-255 0L-200 130A200 56 0 0 0 200 130L255 0A255 72 0 0 1 -255 0Z" /><ellipse class="b1" cx="0" cy="0" rx="255" ry="72" /><ellipse class="gl" cx="0" cy="3" rx="238" ry="65" style="fill: var(--baja-3)" />
            <g id="tik"></g><path class="rim" d="M-255 0A255 72 0 0 1 255 0" /></g>
          <path id="bf" class="k1" d="M-300 0A300 84 0 0 0 300 0V150A300 84 0 0 1 -300 150Z" />
          <g id="bd"><path class="tipis" d="M-300 40A300 84 0 0 0 300 40" /><rect class="s1" x="-64" y="128" width="128" height="30" rx="9" style="fill: var(--utama)" />
            <text x="0" y="149" style="font:600 16px var(--font-kode);fill:var(--teks-di-utama);text-anchor:middle">MASAK</text></g>
          <!-- Lapis 1: tutup berkubah dengan katup uap. -->
          <g id="P1"><path class="k1" d="M-300 -18L-300 0A300 84 0 0 0 300 0L300 -18Z" /><path class="k1" d="M-300 -18C-290 -100 -140 -150 0 -150C140 -150 290 -100 300 -18A300 84 0 0 1 -300 -18Z" />
            <path class="tipis" d="M-250 -70C-200 -112 -120 -132 -40 -136" style="stroke: var(--baja-1);stroke-opacity:0.8;stroke-width:5" />
            <path class="s1" d="M-34 -150V-172H34V-150A34 10 0 0 1 -34 -150Z" /><ellipse class="s1" cx="0" cy="-172" rx="34" ry="10" /><ellipse class="gl" cx="-130" cy="-116" rx="22" ry="6" />
            <path class="rim" d="M-300 -18C-290 -100 -140 -150 0 -150C140 -150 290 -100 300 -18" /></g>
          <!-- Ukuran digambar di benda jadi, mengikuti perspektif. -->
          <g id="ukur"><path class="dim" pathLength="1" d="M-300 160V312M300 160V312" /><path class="dim" pathLength="1" d="M-300 296H300" /><path class="dim" pathLength="1" d="M-390 -146H-336M-390 234H-336" /><path class="dim" pathLength="1" d="M-372 -146V234" />
            <rect class="dp" x="-112" y="270" width="224" height="40" /><text class="dt" x="0" y="300">Ø 280 mm</text>
            <rect class="dp" x="-396" y="62" width="48" height="140" /><text class="dt" x="-364" y="130" transform="rotate(-90 -364 130)">T 180 mm</text></g>
        </g></g>
      </svg>
      <!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: penanak nasi utuh di latar mulus, satu ketukan di tutup. -->
      <div class="isi" data-role="hook">
        <div class="tag" id="tag"><b>KUKUS JAYA · KJ-18 · 1,8 L</b><h1>Penanak nasi,<br>dari dalam.</h1></div>
        <div class="sub" id="s1"><p>Penanak nasi KJ-18. Kita bongkar.</p><small>Servis Elektro Pak Dani</small></div>
      </div>
      <!-- Adegan 2, fakta: lima lapis terangkat satu sumbu, tiap lapis diberi nama dan angkanya. -->
      <div class="isi" data-role="fact" id="fakta">
        <svg class="isi" id="hud1"></svg>
        <div class="sub" id="s2"><p>Lima lapis. Tiap lapis ada gunanya.</p><small>5 komponen · 500 W · 220 V</small></div>
      </div>
      <!-- Adegan 3, bukti: kamera menyelam ke termostat, magnetnya bergerak satu kali. -->
      <div class="isi" data-role="proof" id="bukti">
        <svg class="isi" id="hud2"></svg>
        <div class="sub" id="s3"><p>Magnet lepas di 103 °C, nasi pun berhenti dimasak.</p><small>bagian yang paling sering rusak</small></div>
      </div>
      <!-- Adegan 4, ajakan: lapisan menutup dari bawah, ukuran digambar, kontak bengkel. -->
      <div class="isi" data-role="cta">
        <div class="garis-k" id="gk"></div>
        <div class="kartu" id="kartu"><b>SERVIS ELEKTRO PAK DANI</b><h2>Nasi tak matang?<br>Bongkar di sini.</h2><p>Ganti termostat Rp45.000, selesai 30 menit sambil kamu tunggu.</p><em>Chat 0812-3456-7890</em></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
      const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      function mk(tag, attrs, parent) {
        const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
        Object.entries(attrs).forEach(([k, v]) => e.setAttribute(k, v));
        return parent.appendChild(e);
      }
      const OX = 680, OY = 640, S = 0.74;
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      // Bahan kecil dibuat dari kode: kumparan, pegas, garis ukur di panci.
      function bahan() {
        [235, 190, 145].forEach((r) => {
          mk("ellipse", { class: "kumparan", cx: 0, cy: 4, rx: r, ry: r * 0.28 }, $("kum"));
          mk("ellipse", { class: "nyala", cx: 0, cy: 4, rx: r, ry: r * 0.28 }, $("nyala"));
